data.one_liner: Recommended lints for Flutter apps, packages, and plugins to encourage good coding practices.
data.what_it_does: Provides an additional set of recommended analysis rules and lints on top of flutter_lints to enforce good coding practices and catch potential issues early.
use_when: You want stricter or additional lint rules beyond the standard flutter_lints.
You want to maintain a consistent code style across Flutter apps, packages, or plugins.
avoid_when: You prefer the standard official flutter_lints set without any additions.
The strict rules conflict with your existing project preferences.
strengths: Adds extra useful rules on top of flutter_lints.
Frequently updated with new Dart and Flutter lint rules.
weaknesses: May require extra initial configuration to resolve added lint warnings in existing codebases.
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies and configure the project's analysis_options.yaml to include the rules.
